The issue was caused by the `algorithm="SAMME"` argument in the `AdaBoostClassifier` constructor, which was removed in recent versions of scikit-learn (specifically in version 1.6+). In the installed version (1.9.1), this caused a `TypeError`.

I have removed the `algorithm="SAMME"` argument from `churnmodel/factory.py`, allowing `AdaBoostClassifier` to use its default algorithm. This resolves the `TypeError` and allows the booster to be instantiated and trained as expected.
